collection.description: A storyteller claims that good deeds guarantee a pleasant life after death.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storyteller claims that good deeds guarantee a pleasant life after death.

choices.label: Teach the story as a belief.
Challenge the certainty of the claim.
Focus on kindness in this life.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children discuss kindness without treating reward as certain.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A grieving child asks why good people still suffer.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The storyteller admits that no one can verify the promise.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some listeners feel their faith is being mocked.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers help a struggling neighbor regardless of belief.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A believer explains that present kindness and future hope can coexist.
